# Fusion

Fusion removes the interface elements its recorded description calls unnecessary, leaving a minimalist, distraction-free workspace. Clean typography, reduced chrome and subtle accents are the stated means of emphasizing content, with consistent light and dark appearances.

![Fusion screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zamsyt/obsidian-fusion/HEAD/thumbnail.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Fusion"
    author: "zamsyt"
    repo:   "zamsyt/obsidian-fusion"
    slug:   "fusion"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/fusion"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/zamsyt/obsidian-fusion"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zamsyt/obsidian-fusion/HEAD/thumbnail.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Streamline the Obsidian interface by removing unnecessary visual elements to create a minimalist, distraction-free workspace. Emphasize content with clean typography, reduced chrome, and subtle accents for consistent light and dark appearances."
}
```
